symptom: MPR012 warned on every legacy static/dynamic image widget of a Mendix 11 app on the classic client (Web UI UseOptimizedClient = No), each message saying `mxbuild reports CE0582`, while mx check reported 0 errors: 57 false warnings on one app.
cause: The rule assumed the React client is the only client on Mendix 11 and never read the project's Web UI setting; the executor's check for the same CE0582 (usesReactClient) already did.
insight: When a lint rule and an executor check guard the same CE code, they must share the condition: grep the CE number across mdl/ before writing either. CE0582 is the React client's error, so it is conditional on Web UI UseOptimizedClient == Yes; MigrationMode builds clean too. A rule that claims what mxbuild reports should be measured under each setting, not reasoned from the Mendix version.
